title: Why Goldberger Swallowed Scabs
topic: Why Joseph Goldberger swallowed scabs from sick patients to prove pellagra was not contagious

lines: A physician lifted a sick patient’s scab and popped it into his mouth.
Colleagues laughed, insisting pellagra spread like any germ.
They warned him he’d ruin his career.
He gathers volunteers for a “filth party”.
He injects pellagric blood and even swallows the scabs himself.
You see, it’s like tasting a mystery flavor to prove it isn’t poison.
His self‑experiment shows the disease comes from a poor diet, not an infectious germ.
The irony? His daring act finally silenced critics, yet the cure—niacin—was discovered years later.

claims.claim: Goldberger ran “filth parties” where he and volunteers injected pellagric blood and swallowed scabs to prove pellagra was not contagious.
Critics believed pellagra was an infectious disease, while Goldberger suspected diet was the true cause.
Pellagra is caused by a lack of niacin (vitamin B3) and tryptophan, not by germs.
